answer: Physical Delay Fingerprinting. Each agent must answer a challenge routed through a hardware timing path calibrated to a quartz oscillator whose per-unit drift is unclonable; replies carry a measured timing ripple that verifies the exact device. One operator can buy many devices but cannot clone one oscillator's drift signature. To run N identities, the attacker must physically own N devices plus a unique calibration voyage per unit, so cost scales linearly with fleet size and cannot be amortized across fakes.
